classification.label: Tier 3: Advanced CI Threat / Honeypot
classification.posture_summary: Multiple cross-tier indicators align with targeted human intelligence (HUMINT) or corporate espionage tradecraft. Immediate non-confrontational containment is warranted.

top_drivers.name: Peripheral, USB, or Charging Cable Connection Requests
Requests for Wire Transfers, Loans, or Crypto Investments
Technical Roadmap or Proprietary IP Probing
Isolation from Trusted Advisors or Family
Inquisitiveness Toward Passcodes, MFA, or Credentials
Steering Toward M&A, Governance, or Reorganizations
Premature Declarations of Love or Exclusivity

countermeasures.action: Maintain normal, calm behavioral continuity without confronting the partner, accusing them of espionage, or abruptly terminating contact.
countermeasures.objective: Prevents alerting handler networks and avoids triggering asset extraction, evidence destruction, or immediate leverage deployment.

countermeasures.action: Cease all discussion of real proprietary initiatives and, only if coordinated with corporate security leadership, deploy a benign, slightly altered Canary detail to detect unauthorized onward transmission.
countermeasures.objective: Verifies active intelligence collection passively without risking real corporate harm.

countermeasures.action: Submit corporate smartphones, laptops, and hardware tokens discreetly to the corporate security team for offline forensic inspection; silently rotate corporate passwords and MFA credentials from an uncompromised device; discontinue use of any gifted cables or electronics.
countermeasures.objective: Neutralizes potential spyware payloads, compromised USB peripherals, or lateral corporate network access.

countermeasures.action: Brief the Chief Security Officer (CSO) and Corporate General Counsel under strict attorney-client privilege to coordinate insider-threat defense and external liaison if sovereign intelligence involvement is indicated.
countermeasures.objective: Mobilizes institutional counterintelligence protections while preserving executive legal and reputational safeguards.

canary_protocol.script: During a casual conversation when work arises naturally, mention a strictly benign, non-material scheduling inaccuracy (for example, stating that an internal portfolio review committee moved from Thursday to a non-existent regional retreat next month) using a distinct synthetic internal label agreed with your CSO.
canary_protocol.observation_criteria: Monitor whether that unique synthetic label or distorted review timing resurfaces via external analysts, competitor chatter, unusual partner follow-up queries, or targeted spear-phishing.
canary_protocol.safety_guardrail: Never plant fabricated material non-public information (MNPI) that could violate securities law or cause market distortion; coordinate any deployment with Corporate General Counsel.

legal_disclaimer: OPERATIONAL AND LEGAL DISCLAIMER: This diagnostic report provides structured behavioral risk modeling derived from established counterintelligence and fraud-prevention frameworks. It does not constitute legal advice, a formal background investigation, law enforcement intelligence, or psychological counseling. Do not confront a suspected operative unilaterally. Consult your Chief Security Officer (CSO) and Corporate General Counsel under appropriate legal privilege before acting on elevated findings.
